import importlib.util
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

root=Path.cwd()
crate=root/'sdk-rs/safe-cex-venue-binance'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('controls',crate/'scripts/precision-controls.py')
c=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(c)
c.OUTPUT=root/'sdk-rs/target/binance-pm-lot-size-repeat'
c.ENV=os.environ.copy()
c.ENV['SAFE_CEX_TYPESCRIPT_PATH']='/Users/sam/cs/tealstreet-next/node_modules/typescript'
c.RESULTS={'sha':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'typescript_path':c.ENV['SAFE_CEX_TYPESCRIPT_PATH'],'runs':[],'restored':{}}
prod=crate/'src/pm_orders.rs'
source=crate/'scripts/pm-orders.mjs'
originals={p:p.read_bytes() for p in (prod,source)}
for p in (prod,source,crate/'tests/pm_orders.rs',crate/'tests/support/precision_identity.rs',crate/'scripts/precision-controls.py'):
    assert p.read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{p.relative_to(root)}'])
try:
    c.run('baseline',c.command())
    old=b'adjust((amount - rest) / lots, market.precision.amount)'
    assert originals[prod].count(old)==1
    c.mutate('pm-lot-size',prod,originals[prod],originals[prod].replace(old,old.replace(b'precision.amount',b'precision.price')),'pm','PRECISION-IDENTITY native quantity case 1 row 0')
    marker=b'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify('
    assert originals[source].count(marker)==1
    for name,body in [('same-length',"results[originalTrialCount].amount='3.7';"),('reversal','results.splice(originalTrialCount,8,...results.slice(originalTrialCount).reverse());')]:
        injection=f"if(process.argv.includes('--precision-identity')){{{body}}}\n".encode()
        c.mutate('pm-source-'+name,source,originals[source],originals[source].replace(marker,injection+marker),'pm','PRECISION-IDENTITY source content case 0')
finally:
    c.RESULTS['restored']={str(p.relative_to(root)):p.read_bytes()==b for p,b in originals.items()}
    c.save()
    assert all(c.RESULTS['restored'].values())
c.run('final-restore',c.command())
